added_lines: Principal Evangelist @Databricks | Forbes Tech Council | Keynote Speaker | #4 Top Female Creator Worldwide | Teaching AI to 650,000+ learners
For the last year, enterprise AI has been obsessed with taking humans out of the loop.
made the opposite case: build better systems for humans and AI agents to work together.
But there’s a missing layer needed to make that collaboration work: context.
A living, governed definition of how work actually happens, including processes, rules, exceptions, systems, and human judgment.
Builds and maintains that Map from knowledge spread across documents, systems, and people, while humans approve what becomes part of it.
Captures decisions and exceptions as work happens, so new knowledge can be proposed back into the Map instead of getting lost.
Turn approved context into execution while keeping agents and workflows within defined boundaries.
The bigger shift is that context stops being something an agent simply retrieves at runtime and becomes part of the operating system of work itself.
The future of work isn’t just about giving agents more intelligence.
It’s about giving humans and agents the shared context they need to work well together.

added_lines: UiPath Platform is valued for its end-to-end automation capabilities, low-code/no-code interfaces, and integration with diverse applications like SAP and Excel. Key features include the Orchestrator for centralized management, Studio's drag-and-drop functionality, and robust AI-driven capabilities such as Document Understanding. It offers a strong community support system alongside comprehensive training via UiPath Academy. Users benefit from automation efficiency, reduced human error, and significant time savings, making it accessible to both technical and non-technical audiences across various industries.
"With the recent automations I have developed, I have been able to save about five hundred hours per quarter with an Excel-based automation that used to be clumsy."

Some areas needing improvement for UiPath Platform include enhancing its licensing model to be more affordable and straightforward for smaller businesses. Users highlight a need for better debugging capabilities and a more intuitive user interface. The system's stability and performance, particularly when dealing with updates and large-scale automation, also require attention. Compatibility issues with legacy systems and integration challenges with third-party platforms are noted. There is a call for improved customer support and clearer documentation, particularly when new features or versions are released. Additionally, increasing AI capabilities and addressing complexity in automation setups could enhance user experience and adoption.
"One piece of feedback I have is regarding the product documentation."

Many companies using UiPath Platform have reported positive returns. They've experienced significant time savings, with automation reducing processing hours by 70% to 80%. Some organizations saved up to 20,000 hours annually and cut costs by 30% to 40%. Revenue increases were also noted, with some achieving 300% ROI. The automation has freed employee time for more complex tasks, enhanced efficiency, and reduced human errors across departments such as finance, HR, and sales.

UiPath Platform users report varied experiences with pricing and licensing, frequently describing costs as high but offset by the platform’s robust capabilities and potential for ROI. Enterprise users appreciate the comprehensive features, though they note that the pricing structure can be complex. The cost of unattended bots is particularly highlighted as expensive compared to competitors. UiPath's Community Edition allows for initial trials, but the Enterprise edition's value often justifies the investment for large-scale automation solutions, despite higher licensing fees.

Organizations use UiPath Platform primarily for streamlining various business processes through automation. Common use cases include automating repetitive tasks, improving accuracy in document processing, and integrating systems for efficient data transfer. Businesses automate tasks like invoice processing, user onboarding, financial reconciliations, and data extraction. UiPath helps reduce manual efforts and minimize errors, thus freeing up employee time for more strategic activities. It is effective in sectors like finance, healthcare, supply chain, HR, and IT operations, allowing scalable process automation.

UiPath Platform's customer support receives praise for being knowledgeable, proactive, and timely. Many users appreciate the responsive technical support and active community. Some issues with initial responses and delays exist, especially when dealing with complex tickets. Premium support provides better response times and solutions. Overall, users find the support helpful, though some suggest faster ticket handling. The community forum and documentation are valuable resources for resolving issues, enhancing the support experience.

Most users find UiPath Platform's initial setup straightforward and manageable, taking hours to days depending on complexity and environment. Cloud deployments generally simplify the process, while on-premise setups might need more coordination due to IT security and integration needs. Some users experience challenges in configuration or integration but often overcome these with support from UiPath resources. Familiarity with UiPath's documentation can ease the setup experience significantly.

UiPath Platform users express satisfaction with its scalability, noting how teams effortlessly handle hundreds of bots and automate numerous processes. Many comment on the platform's adaptability across various departments and industries, appreciating the ease of expansion through additional licenses. They identify infrastructure and licensing costs as potential barriers but laud its capabilities to increase automation smoothly as organizations grow. Various features and integrations support scalability, making it versatile for varying business needs.

UiPath Platform receives mixed feedback on stability. Many find it highly reliable, noting improved stability over the years, especially in cloud deployments. It integrates well with diverse systems, but can face issues during application updates or incorrect configurations by developers. Some users report needing better error handling and encounter occasional bugs or performance lags. Stability varies with infrastructure and developer expertise, often requiring experienced handling for optimal performance.

Users recommend seamless integration for cloud-based operations and better automation of processes involving legacy systems and Citrix environments.
"I feel the pricing, setup cost, and licensing can be a little confusing for the clients, and there is work that can be done around that."

Companies using UiPath Platform report significant ROI through time and cost savings. Automation reduces invoice processing time by 60-75% and boosts data accuracy by over 90%. Several departments, like finance and HR, benefit from automation. Firms save thousands of hours annually, leading to millions in cost avoidance. While initial costs exist, returns often appear within 6-12 months. Many have reduced human errors, seen increased capacity, and avoided hiring additional staff.

Enterprise users of UiPath Platform frequently highlight its higher cost compared to competitors such as Microsoft Power Automate and Automation Anywhere. The platform offers a variety of licensing options, including a free Community Edition, but the Enterprise Edition can be perceived as expensive, especially for small businesses. Licensing complexity adds challenges, with additional costs often incurred for features like Document Understanding and AI components. Despite the costs, enterprises appreciate the significant ROI, flexibility, and robust automation capabilities UiPath provides.

Organizations primarily utilize UiPath Platform for business process automation, focusing on streamlining repetitive and manual tasks. Users highlight its application in automating finance, HR, supply chain, and IT processes. They mention integrating AI functionalities for invoice processing, document understanding, and intelligent data capture. Teams utilize unattended bots for tasks like data extraction, reconciliation, and invoice processing, significantly reducing manual interventions. Many companies deploy UiPath Platform on both cloud and on-premises, depending on specific business needs.

UiPath Platform's customer service and support are responsive and knowledgeable, with rapid response times, often addressing issues within 24-48 hours. Users appreciate the technical team's willingness to help and the community support, which provides additional resources. Some users note occasional delays in complex cases, but overall, the support is considered reliable. The platform offers premium support packages, enhancing service quality for those who opt for it, ensuring efficient resolution and user satisfaction.

Most users find UiPath Platform's initial setup straightforward and easy, often taking from a few hours to a couple of days. The installation process is simplified with clear documentation and support, even for on-premises and cloud deployments. While some experience challenges with specific configurations or technical environments, many praise the setup for being logical and manageable, even for those without extensive technical expertise, and appreciate the smooth transition and integration.

UiPath Platform is highly scalable, adaptable across various organizations and needs. Users can seamlessly add bots and licenses, enhancing their automation capabilities. The platform's modular design supports diverse processes, allowing multiple robots to operate concurrently without infrastructure concerns. This flexibility allows for growth but depends on the organization's licenses and technical expertise. While stable for many, some highlight challenges with large-scale deployments. Nonetheless, UiPath continues to impress with its scalability features.

Users express mixed opinions on UiPath Platform's stability. Many praise its reliability, rating it between eight and ten, and appreciate its robust performance. Issues noted include occasional crashes, errors, and challenges with updates. Some find it less stable with complex tasks or integrations, while others see improvements with recent versions. Factors like infrastructure and external applications often affect perceived stability.
